text_block_list.text:
I was training with Rice Shower, but her 
movements seemed sluggish...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Big Brother... I think I 
might have pushed myself too hard in the 
last race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Big Sister... I think I might 
have pushed myself too hard in the last 
race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, but... I'm okay! Big Brother, please 
don't worry...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, but... I'm okay! Big Sister, please 
don't worry...!

It seems the fatigue from the race still 
lingers. Maybe I pushed her too hard. I'll 
need to be more careful...
